method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, operation-by-operation reverse paraphrase, and exact formula, macro, token and identifier comparison after a bounded fresh check of official Marathi structural-rule terminology; not independent or human review.
scope: The LK structural-rules section: the motivation for rearranging formulas, left and right weakening, contraction and exchange, double inference lines, and the cut rule.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The section is titled Structural Rules. Logical rules act only on formulas at an extreme end of the premise, so exchange moves formulas into the required position; duplicate formulas may also be combined and a formula may be added on either side.
samples.checks: The translation preserves correct position rather than mistranslating right position as the right-hand side. Premise, both extreme positions, combining identical formulas and adding on either side are all explicit.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Left and right weakening add A to the corresponding side. Left and right contraction reduce two adjacent copies of A to one.
samples.checks: All four rule trees, side labels, contexts and formula multiplicities are byte-identical to the source; only the subsection headings are translated.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Left and right exchange swap adjacent A and B while preserving every surrounding context.
samples.checks: The A,B to B,A order and the distinct Gamma, Pi, Delta and Lambda contexts are unchanged. अदलाबदल is definition-controlled by these displayed rules.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A chain of weakening, contraction and exchange inferences is often shown with double inference lines. Cut, though not strictly necessary, makes derivations easier to reuse and combine: from Gamma entails Delta,A and A,Pi entails Lambda, infer Gamma,Pi entails Delta,Lambda.
samples.checks: The qualification that cut is dispensable, its practical role, both premises, eliminated A and merged contexts are preserved. The complete cut proof tree is byte-identical.

limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
No exact Marathi proof-theory occurrence of the four structural-rule labels was found in the bounded official-domain searches.
आकुंचन has direct general official lexical support; its proof-theory use is fixed by the displayed duplicate-formula rule.
दुर्बलीकरण, अदलाबदल and कट are transparent, definition-controlled provisional labels open to specialist correction; विपर्यय, विनिमय and छेद were recorded as alternatives.
